items.name: vue-pointing-cursor
items.title: Vue Pointing Cursor
items.description: An oversized Vue 3 cursor with curved motion, follow mode, replaceable SVG shapes, and click animation.
items.author: Alexey Murz Korepov
items.docs: Installs into components/ui/pointing-cursor (plus the js-pointing-cursor npm dependency). Import from @/components/ui/pointing-cursor. Demo: https://murznn.github.io/js-pointing-cursor/vue/
